hooks.quote: So I asked him why the server was down, and he said: it's not down, it's just thinking really hard about its life choices.
hooks.caption_suggestion: He Did Not See That Coming

hooks.quote: After three weeks of testing, the cheapest setup beat every expensive one we tried, and the reason is not what you think. It all came down to one setting nobody touches.
